[{"nspname":"public","proname":"report_collector_heartbeat","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.report_collector_heartbeat(p_name text, p_success boolean, p_records integer DEFAULT 0, p_error text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE sql\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n    INSERT INTO metadata.collector_status (\n        collector_name, last_run_at, last_success_at, run_count,\n        error_count, consecutive_errors, last_error,\n        records_collected_today, status, updated_at\n    )\n    VALUES (\n        p_name, NOW(),\n        CASE WHEN p_success THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END,\n        1,\n        CASE WHEN p_success THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,\n        CASE WHEN p_success THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,\n        p_error, p_records,\n        CASE WHEN p_success THEN 'idle' ELSE 'error' END,\n        NOW()\n    )\n    ON CONFLICT (collector_name) DO UPDATE SET\n        last_run_at = NOW(),\n        last_success_at = CASE\n            WHEN p_success THEN NOW()\n            ELSE collector_status.last_success_at\n        END,\n        run_count = collector_status.run_count + 1,\n        error_count = CASE\n            WHEN p_success THEN collector_status.error_count\n            ELSE collector_status.error_count + 1\n        END,\n        consecutive_errors = CASE\n            WHEN p_success THEN 0\n            ELSE collector_status.consecutive_errors + 1\n        END,\n        last_error = COALESCE(p_error, collector_status.last_error),\n        records_collected_today = CASE\n            WHEN collector_status.updated_at::date < CURRENT_DATE THEN p_records\n            ELSE collector_status.records_collected_today + p_records\n        END,\n        status = CASE\n            WHEN p_success THEN 'idle'\n            ELSE 'error'\n        END,\n        updated_at = NOW();\n$function$\n"}]
